### [Enumerable members](Exposure/EnumerableMembers.cs)

- **A member another class calls returns no enumerable**

- **An enumerable parameter is referenced exactly once**

  ```
      its Members.SelectMany(ParametersReadOtherThanOnce) is empty
  ```
- **The references to a parameter are the names that resolve to it**\
  `References in Method(method) is references`

  | method                                                                  | references |
  | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
  | "int Count(IEnumerable<int> rows) => rows.Count();"                     | 1          |
  | "int Twice(IEnumerable<int> rows) => rows.Count() + rows.Sum();"        | 2          |
  | "int Max(IEnumerable<int> rows) => rows.Max(row => new[] { row }.Max(r… | 1          |

- **A parameter holds an enumerable however its type is written**\
  `Holds an enumerable Method(method) is true`

  | method                                         |
  | ---------------------------------------------- |
  | "int Count(IEnumerable<int> rows) => 0;"       |
  | "int Count(Rows rows) => 0;"                   |
  | "int Count(Func<IEnumerable<int>> rows) => 0;" |
  | "int Count(IEnumerable<int>[] rows) => 0;"     |

- **A type that only implements one holds none**\
  `Holds an enumerable Method(method) is false`

  | method                                     |
  | ------------------------------------------ |
  | "int Count(IReadOnlyList<int> rows) => 0;" |
  | "int Count(string rows) => 0;"             |

## Idioms

### [Append chains](Idioms/AppendChains.cs)

### [Catches](Idioms/Catches.cs)

- **No catch takes every exception**
  ```
  For each of Source.Projects:
      its Nodes<CatchClauseSyntax>() has none takes everything
  ```
- **A catch takes every exception** — `Takes everything CatchIn(clause) is true`

  | clause                                                 |
  | ------------------------------------------------------ |
  | "catch { }"                                            |
  | "catch (Exception) { }"                                |
  | "catch (System.Exception e) { }"                       |
  | "catch (global::System.Exception e) { }"               |
  | "catch (Exception e) when (e is TimeoutException) { }" |
  | "catch (Exception e) { if (cancelled) throw; }"        |
  | "catch (Exception e) { Log(e); throw; }"               |
  | "catch (Exception e) { throw Malformed(e); }"          |
  | "catch (Error) { }"                                    |

- **A catch takes only the types it names or rethrows**\
  `Takes everything CatchIn(clause) is false`

  | clause                                                  |
  | ------------------------------------------------------- |
  | "catch (TimeoutException) { }"                          |
  | "catch (IOException e) when (e.HResult == 32) { }"      |
  | "catch (Exception e) when (Log(e)) { throw; }"          |
  | "catch (Exception e) when (Log(e) && false) { throw; }" |

### [Clause braces](Layout/ClauseBraces.cs)

- **A clause takes braces unless it is a simple statement**
  ```
  For each of Source.Projects:
      its Nodes<StatementSyntax>() has none misbraced
  ```
- **A statement braces its clauses** — `Misbraced in statement is empty`

  | statement                                        |
  | ------------------------------------------------ |
  | "if (a) F();"                                    |
  | "if (a) F(); else if (b) G(); else H();"         |
  | "if (a) { F(); G(); }"                           |
  | "if (a) { var x = F(); }"                        |
  | "foreach (var x in xs) { if (x) F(); }"          |
  | "if (a) { while (b) { if (c) F(); } } else G();" |
  | "using (scope) return F();"                      |

- **A statement misbraces one clause** — `Misbraced in statement has one item`

  | statement                                         |
  | ------------------------------------------------- |
  | "if (a) { F(); }"                                 |
  | "if (a) F(); else { G(); }"                       |
  | "while (a) if (b) F();"                           |
  | "if (a) { while (b) if (c) F(); } else G();"      |
  | "foreach (var x in xs) foreach (var y in x) F();" |
  | "using (scope) { F(); }"                          |

- **Members are one empty line apart unless two single line ones of a kind**

- **These members are spaced as 1 1g says** — `Misspaced TypeOf(declaration) is empty`

  | declaration                                                        |
  | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
  | "class C {     int a;     int b; }"                                |
  | "class C {     int A() => 1;     int B() => 2; }"                  |
  | "class C {     const int A = 1;      int b; }"                     |
  | "class C {     /// <summary>A.</summary>     int a;      int b; }" |

- **These are not** — `Misspaced TypeOf(declaration) has one item`

  | declaration                                                       |
  | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | "class C {     int a;      int b; }"                              |
  | "class C {     const int A = 1;     int b; }"                     |
  | "class C {     /// <summary>A.</summary>     int a;     int b; }" |
  | "class C {     [Fact]     void A() { }     void B() { } }"        |
  | "class C {     void A() { }       void B() { } }"                 |
